news.title: Anthropic的纳斯达克上市之路变得更加崎岖
news.snippet: AI领域虽然热度不减，但Anthropic的纳斯达克上市之路正面临更多波折与障碍。
news.raw_snippet:
"Everybody's still full steam ahead on AI, but all the things around it took an interesting turn this week," Daniel Newman, CEO at Futurum Group, told CNBC in an interview on Friday. The hyperscalers' results have "raised eyebrows" and created a new headwind in the market, which is "more doubt on capital structure," he said. [...] Anthropic didn't immediately respond to a request for comment.

A big tail wind for Anthropic remains AI demand. [...] Analysts at Citizens wrote in a Thursday report that the announcement "put the biggest investor fear to rest — that funding its enormous AI infrastructure buildout would require an open-ended increase in debt and equity issuance."

Attention will now turn back from hyperscaler earnings to Anthropic, as investors assess how much risk they're willing to assume and at what price.

news.title: 美国AI建设的新瓶颈：廉价资金短缺 — WSJ
news.snippet: 美国AI建设依赖廉价资金多年，如今资金成本上升，成为数据中心和基础设施扩张的新瓶颈。
news.raw_snippet:
For years, the companies behind America’s artificial-intelligence boom have raised hundreds of billions of dollars with ease. Wall Street eagerly ponied up capital and asked few questions.

Now, the balance of power is shifting. [...] Lenders and investors are getting choosier about where to place their bets and are demanding tougher terms, signaling a new phase in the AI build-out. Among their concerns: the prospect of delays in big projects as a grassroots political backlash to data centers gains traction, and the threat that AI-related profits from hyperscalers and startups such as Anthropic and OpenAI won’t materialize as fast as promised. [...] Plus, a flood of stock and bond offerings is compounding concerns that investors are getting overexposed to AI.
